title: A War Without Victory — Campaign Auditions Revised v2
scope: Eight revised complete original campaign auditions addressing musician feedback; all original titles retained. No comparison reel or runtime adoption.
status: Owner reports Almedin approved all eight Revised v2 tracks as a musical package. Technical review GO; runtime adoption and separate global acceptance gates remain unchanged.

feedback_and_response.feedback: Almedin liked the recorded instruments but heard broken/fading sound and too-similar themes. Owner explicitly required keeping all eight.
feedback_and_response.response: New independent melodies and phrase-level arrangements; no unconditional bar-end cropping; sustained bowed/wind sample bodies extended with crossfaded stable interior regions, musical releases/ties and deliberate wind breaths. Piano/harp remain naturally decaying.
feedback_and_response.not_an_acceptance_claim: Energy, seam, hash and codec checks establish technical behavior. They cannot establish natural expression, distinct emotional character, memorability or expert approval.

sample_library.credits: VSCO2CE, recorded by Sam Gossner and Simon Dalzell; sample cutting Elan Hickler / Soundemote; Versilian Studios. Upright piano: Ivy Audio / Simon Dalzell, distributed by Versilian Studios. These are third-party recorded sample resources, not project-recorded orchestral performances.
sample_library.reuse: Previously pinned and measured v3/v4/first-suite sample caches; no new downloads. Fourteen first-suite added anchors and earlier string/piano pitch proof are reused; needed files verified against pinned Git blob hashes.

stem_groups.piano: Recorded upright piano and/or harp; unused slot silent
stem_groups.strings: Recorded cello, viola and violin; no percussion in this revision
stem_groups.winds: Recorded sustained F horn, clarinet and bassoon; unused slot silent
stem_groups.room: Bounded additive stereo reflections derived from recorded instruments

rendering.stems: Four additive PCM24 WAV slots per track, plus master WAV, MP3 and OGG; 56 exports total.
rendering.method: Retained recorded attack. Stable interior body for bow/wind sustain, stereo phase-error endpoint search and 80ms raised-cosine linear overlap. No bar-based envelope/reset. Phrase-level linear releases with original source texture, bounded winds and explicit breaths. Natural piano/harp never loop. Common mastering gain preserves dynamics; no limiter.
rendering.limits: Continuity diagnostics establish signal behavior only, not musical taste. Bow/wind extension repeats a crossfaded real recorded interior body. No physical modelling, new recording or piano/harp infinite sustain. Actual sustained F horn, not a physical muted horn; harp, not guitar.
rendering.editable_score_notes: Each retained score.json includes explicit event time/duration/pitch/velocity/voice/phrase/articulation/release and section/harmony/tempo maps. Authored source phrase scores are in SCORES. These audition inputs are frozen; changes require a new reviewed freeze and new attempt, never overwriting these artifacts.

runtime.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.2-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

prior_preservation.result: 349 prior files remain byte-exact; root separately checks runtime audio assets and approved opening exports.

validation.tests: Seven targeted unittest checks: retained RED, failing pitch-range gate then GREEN. tests-red.log, tests-green01.log, tests-green02.log.
validation.held_proof: continuity-proof/*_held_v2.wav and preflight.json: ten-second held-note diagnostic, no bar-boundary reset, phrase-end fade, naturally decaying piano/harp. Comparison is against old two-second-bar clip mechanism, not a new user comparison reel.
validation.independent_pre_render: Reviewer tested all 84 used bowed/wind variants, including viola: continuous late bodies, bounded seam differences and no silent joins. independent-continuity.json/log. Technical readiness only.
validation.render_reports: Each KEY-attempt01 contains render-report.json, loudness logs, frozen score, full note-to-sample and sustain-loop assignments, pinned sample-source credits and hashes, CC0 license and all seven exports.
validation.pending: Final independent source/provenance verdict, real-browser 16-file proof and private delivery receipts are added by root.
validation.independent_final_artifacts: independent-artifact-verification.json/log: all 8 tracks, 56 export hashes, 40 actual WAV PCM hashes/formats/endpoints, stem reconstruction within 2 LSB, 37 pinned source files and all 349 prior files passed; exit 0. This independent evidence is reused, not duplicated.

retained_failures.reason: New functionality absent before implementation; seven required behavior checks failed.

Cheap full-score range validation rejected pitches beyond existing verified anchors. Explicit authored pitches/registers corrected before prepare/freeze/full rendering; no new samples fetched or prior source changed.

tracks.title: A Country Before Dawn
tracks.creative_intent: Broad string melody with rising fifth and suspended falls, long bowed floor, restrained sustained F horn answers; expansive 6/8 horizon.
tracks.level_note: Around -19 LUFS target reached using common linear gain.

tracks.title: Lines on Paper
tracks.creative_intent: Measured piano counterpoint in 4/4; irregular right-hand sentences against an independent left hand and a long string pedal.
tracks.level_note: Sparse naturally decaying piano is peak-limited by common linear gain; target around -19 LUFS is not reached. Dynamics retained; no limiter or claim of equal perceived loudness.

tracks.title: The Long Winter
tracks.creative_intent: Low cello lament in slow 3/4, descending and withheld notes, separate bassoon breaths and sparse chamber support.
tracks.level_note: Around -19 LUFS target reached using common linear gain.

tracks.title: No Answer on the Radio
tracks.creative_intent: Low suspense in 7/8 with continuous E carrier pedal, chromatic horn questions and unequal 3+2+2 piano punctuation.
tracks.level_note: Around -19 LUFS target reached using common linear gain.

tracks.title: The Life We Remember
tracks.creative_intent: Warm G-major clarinet arches in 6/8, recorded harp figures, slowly moving cello and viola warmth.
tracks.level_note: Around -19 LUFS target reached using common linear gain.

tracks.title: A Table for Strangers
tracks.creative_intent: Conversational piano and clarinet in 3/2, chamber bass and long viola suspensions; deliberately spacious, unresolved exchanges.
tracks.level_note: Sparse naturally decaying piano is peak-limited by common linear gain; target around -19 LUFS is not reached. Dynamics retained; no limiter or claim of equal perceived loudness.

tracks.title: What the Maps Cannot Show
tracks.creative_intent: A broad slow 4/4 cello elegy in C minor that grows into divided full strings, then returns to one voice.
tracks.level_note: Around -19 LUFS target reached using common linear gain.

tracks.title: After the Guns
tracks.creative_intent: Tentative low woodwind voice opens into warmer clarinet, quiet harp and fragile string warmth in 6/8; no victory cadence or borrowed theme.
tracks.level_note: Around -19 LUFS target reached using common linear gain.

approval: Auditions only. Instruments include actual harp and sustained F horn; no guitar/physical muted-horn claim, borrowed melody, anthem, voice, folk quotation or triumphant combat cue. All previous auditions and game music remain unchanged.
